title: Harden live Docker self-host acceptance gate

context.summary: Make the live Docker self-host acceptance path an explicit release gate and add backup/restore smoke coverage.
context.background: TASK-120 verifies public pre-release bootstrap assets without starting Docker. The next gate must verify the live self-host stack lifecycle through installer startup, runtime acceptance, backup/restore smoke and uninstall.

in: Add an explicit selfhost:gate command for the live Docker release gate.
Keep selfhost:acceptance dry-run in pnpm check.
Add backup/restore smoke coverage to dry-run and live self-host acceptance.
Document the release-gate command and its dry-run option.
Validate gate wiring through the existing dry-run acceptance path.
out: Running the full live Docker gate in normal pnpm check.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm selfhost:gate runs the live self-host acceptance with MINDORY_SELFHOST_ACCEPTANCE_LIVE=true.
pnpm selfhost:gate -- --dry-run runs the non-Docker dry-run acceptance path.
Dry-run self-host acceptance creates a real config-only backup and restores it before uninstall.
Live self-host acceptance creates a runtime backup and runs a restore smoke that does not replace live PostgreSQL data.
Docs and release checklist refer to pnpm selfhost:gate as the live Docker release gate.
pnpm selfhost:acceptance, pnpm selfhost:gate -- --dry-run, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Run pnpm selfhost:gate on a Docker-capable machine before final public release.
Confirm the live gate still leaves temporary MINDORY_HOME directories cleaned up.

risks: The full live gate is intentionally expensive and remains opt-in outside final release checks.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
